basic_details.job_title: MGU Senior System Analyst Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mahatma Gandhi University has invited applications for one Senior System Analyst post in its IT Cell, on temporary contract for one year, extendable up to two years based on performance, at Rs.1,25,000 per month. Applicants need a Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science and Applications/Computer Engineering/IT and not less than 5 years as System Analyst in medium to large e-governance projects. Send the bio-data by email to [email protected] on or before 19 November 2026, 5 pm, and one set by post to the Registrar.

important_dates.interview_date: Communicated by email to shortlisted candidates

how_to_apply: Prepare a bio-data that carries your own valid email id and mobile phone number.
Scan the certificates in proof of qualification, marks, experience, age, caste etc.
Email the bio-data with the scanned copies to [email protected] on or before 19 November 2026, 5 pm.
Send one set of the bio-data with copies of the certificates by post to: The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, P D Hills P O, Kottayam-686560.
Write the name of the post on the envelope and mention it in the application.
important_instructions: Applications received after the prescribed date will not be considered. Applicants must have their own valid email id and mobile phone number, mentioned in the bio-data. The name of the post should be superscribed on the envelope and mentioned in the application. Extension of the contract beyond one year, up to two years, is based on performance.

content_sections.heading: About Mahatma Gandhi University
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University is a university whose notification is issued from P D Hills P O, Kottayam-686560, over the signature of the Registrar (i/c). The notification, dated 07.11.2026, invites applications for engagement to one post in the IT Cell.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.details: Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science and Applications/Computer Engineering/IT from recognized University/Institution
Added qualification in Cyber Security/Data Analysis/ Business Data Processing
Not less than 5 (Five) years as System Analyst in medium to large e-governance projects of reputed organizations
Not more than 50 years as on 01.01.2026

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs.1,25,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Twenty Five Thousand Only) per month. The engagement is on temporary contract basis for a period of one year, extendable up to two years based on performance. The notice mentions no allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU SENIOR SYSTEM ANALYST- IT CELL
content_sections.text: Prepare a bio-data that carries your own valid email id and mobile phone number. Scan the certificates in proof of qualification, marks, experience, age, caste etc. Email the bio-data with the scanned copies to [email protected] on or before 19 November 2026, 5 pm. Send one set of the bio-data with copies of the certificates by post to: The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, P D Hills P O, Kottayam-686560. Write the name of the post on the envelope and mention it in the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says the date and time of the interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through their email id. It does not describe how candidates are shortlisted.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MGU Senior System Analyst recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) vacancy for the post of Senior System Analyst- IT Cell at Mahatma Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Bio-data must be emailed on or before 19 November 2026, 5 pm. Applications received after the prescribed date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science and Applications/Computer Engineering/IT from a recognized University/Institution is essential, with not less than 5 years as System Analyst in medium to large e-governance projects of reputed organizations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must be not more than 50 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Senior System Analyst?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.1,25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the bio-data with scanned certificates to [email protected], and send one set by post to The Registrar, Mahatma Gandhi University, P D Hills P O, Kottayam-686560, with the post name on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary contract engagement for one year, extendable up to two years based on performance.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are informed of the interview date and time through their email id.

faq.question: Q9. Which additional qualifications are desirable?
faq.answer: Added qualification in Cyber Security/Data Analysis/ Business Data Processing is desirable.

faq.question: Q10. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The name of the post, Senior System Analyst- IT Cell, should be superscribed on the envelope and mentioned in the application.
